overview: The original collection comprises 54 one-bedroom apartments, 54 two-bedroom apartments and four three-bedroom penthouses.
research.locationNote: Dubai Islands. Confirm the selected home’s outlook and access arrangements; travel times in marketing are approximate.
research.priceNote: No live developer price published. Property Finder shows an AED 2.5 million headline, AED 2.1 million one-bedroom and AED 3.2 million two-bedroom references, with sold-out labels. Availability is unconfirmed.
research.paymentNote: Developer reference: 20% booking, 40% construction and 40% completion. Broker instalments below are historical. Property Finder labels the final 40% post-handover, conflicting with the developer’s completion trigger.
research.handoverNote: Imtiaz expects November 2026; the broker registry summary retains December 2026. Both are Q4 forecasts, not certified delivery.
